beaches.name: Kardamena beach (nudist spots)
beaches.summary: Nudist spots exist somewhere around Kardamena; the municipality does not say where. The Municipality of Kos tourism site lists 'σημεία γυμνιστών' among the resort's attractions without locating them; the organised beach in front of the village has sunbeds and water sports.

beaches.name: Tigaki (west of the salt lake)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established on the dune-backed stretch west of the salt lake. A naturist directory carries reports from the 1990s through 2024; a 2002 claim that the stretch was declared official names no authority, and one report mentions a 'nudism is prohibited' sign while use continues.

beaches.name: Magic/Exotic Beach (Polemi)
beaches.summary: A nudist sunbed section operates at the eastern end of Magic beach. A naturist directory carries reports from 2000 to 2024; the sunbed owner accepts naturists and a red sign reading 'No nudists. No FKK' marks the boundary with the textile section. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Cavo Paradiso
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the ends of the beach and on the sandy beach beyond the rocks. A naturist directory carries reports from 2005 to 2024; an FKK sign on the access track was gone by 2016 and the sunbed area is largely swimwear in high season.
